H-X is not used: X is dense and the section 5 lemma gives the kernel line comes from the block Krylov system with rank criterion rank K = N+m-1, witness X = [I|0], Y = identity, degree <= 2N in X and in Y, Schwartz-Zippel 2N/2^128 < 2^-67, charged loose at 2^-30.
